public_body: Great Barrington Housing Authority Board Of Commissioners
overall: Board violated the Open Meeting Law by discussing non-permissible topics (the Executive Director's evaluation and professional competence) in executive session; violation found intentional, with training and certification ordered.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board improperly went into executive session on May 21 to discuss the Executive Director's annual evaluations, which belonged in open session.
allegations.key_passage: Here, during the May 21 executive session, the Board reviewed the evaluation process to date, which was not a permissible topic for executive session.

allegations.summary: Complainant urged that the executive session violation was intentional, citing prior Attorney General advice and the objection raised at the meeting.
allegations.key_passage: We therefore find the Board’s violation to be intentional.

remedy: We order the Board’s immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.

We order all members of the Board who participated in the improper executive session, and who are still serving on the Board, to attend an Open Meeting Law webinar training provided by our office within ninety (90) days of the Board’s receipt of this letter.
We also order the Board to certify to our office that these same Board members have completed the webinar training within ninety-five (95) days of the Board’s receipt of this letter.
